items.titulo: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost
items.resumen: Samaya AI’s Sterling is a post-trained Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model for financial research. It scores 58.9% on FrontierFinance at $0.61 per question, beating Claude Fable 5.1’s 55.9% at $6.89. items.titulo: Edge0 Releases Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B Voice Cloning TTS Model
items.resumen: Edge0 released Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B open-weight zero-shot voice cloning TTS model under Apache 2.0. It supports 23 languages and adds a final GRPO stage driven by a learned realism critic. The post Edge0 Releases Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B Voice Cloning TTS Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
